ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 12, 2018 and to business minors on Monday, November 19, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Informatics Minors on Monday, November 26, 2018 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Curric Unassigned or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Business or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Informatics or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s) or minor(s).
